mapper.select: select date_format(stat_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, customer_id as customerId, operator_user_id as operatorUserId, inbound_customer_flag as inboundCustomerFlag, contacted_customer_flag as contactedCustomerFlag, new_wechat_friend_flag as newWechatFriendFlag, dial_count as dialCount, connected_count as connectedCount, call_over_1min_count as callOver1minCount, call_over_3min_count as callOver3minCount, call_duration_sec as callDurationSec from report_employee_follow_analysis_fact_day where stat_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} order by stat_date asc, customer_id asc, operator_user_id asc

select date_format(from_unixtime(c.collection_time / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, c.id as customerId, c.owner as operatorUserId, 1 as inboundCustomerFlag, 0 as contactedCustomerFlag, 0 as newWechatFriendFlag, 0 as dialCount, 0 as connectedCount, 0 as callOver1minCount, 0 as callOver3minCount, 0 as callDurationSec from customer c where c.in_shared_pool is false and c.collection_time is not null and c.collection_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

select t.statDate, t.customerId, t.operatorUserId, 0 as inboundCustomerFlag, 1 as contactedCustomerFlag, 0 as newWechatFriendFlag, 0 as dialCount, 0 as connectedCount, 0 as callOver1minCount, 0 as callOver3minCount, 0 as callDurationSec from ( select date_format(from_unixtime(f.follow_time / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, f.customer_id as customerId, f.owner as operatorUserId from follow_up_record f join customer c on c.id = f.customer_id where c.in_shared_pool is false and f.follow_time is not null and f.follow_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by date_format(from_unixtime(f.follow_time / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d'), f.customer_id, f.owner ) t

select date_format(from_unixtime(cra.begin_timestamp / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, c.id as customerId, su.id as operatorUserId, 0 as inboundCustomerFlag, 0 as contactedCustomerFlag, 0 as newWechatFriendFlag,
count(1) as dialCount,
sum(case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as connectedCount,
sum(case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 and ifnull(cra.duration, 0) >= 60 then 1 else 0 end) as callOver1minCount,
sum(case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 and ifnull(cra.duration, 0) >= 180 then 1 else 0 end) as callOver3minCount,
sum(case when ifnull(cra.is_connected, 0) = 1 then ifnull(cra.duration, 0) else 0 end) as callDurationSec from mmba_call_record_audit cra join sys_user su on su.um = cra.um join customer c on c.mobile = cra.customer_tel and c.owner = su.id and c.in_shared_pool is false where cra.begin_timestamp between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and cra.direction = 0 and cra.customer_tel is not null and cra.customer_tel != '' group by date_format(from_unixtime(cra.begin_timestamp / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d'), c.id, su.id

select date_format(from_unixtime(a.`timestamp` / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, c.id as customerId, su.id as operatorUserId, 0 as inboundCustomerFlag, 0 as contactedCustomerFlag, 1 as newWechatFriendFlag, 0 as dialCount, 0 as connectedCount, 0 as callOver1minCount, 0 as callOver3minCount, 0 as callDurationSec from mmba_wx_friend_change_audit a join sys_user su on su.um = a.um join customer c on c.mobile = a.friend_phone and c.owner = su.id and c.in_shared_pool is false where a.`timestamp` between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and a.is_friend = '1' and a.friend_phone is not null and a.friend_phone != '' group by date_format(from_unixtime(a.`timestamp` / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d'), c.id, su.id

select sou.user_id as operatorUserId, su.name as employeeName, sou.department_id as departmentId, sd.name as departmentName from sys_organization_user sou join sys_user su on su.id = sou.user_id left join sys_department sd on sd.id = sou.department_id where sou.organization_id = #{orgId} and ifnull(sou.enable, true) = true order by ifnull(sd.pos, 0) asc, su.name asc
select sd.id as departmentId, sd.name as departmentName from sys_department sd where sd.organization_id = #{orgId} order by ifnull(sd.pos, 0) asc, sd.name asc

select c.id as customerId, c.name as customerName, c.mobile, c.owner as ownerId, su.name as ownerName, sou.department_id as departmentId, sd.name as departmentName, cf.field_value as customerSource from customer c left join sys_user su on su.id = c.owner left join sys_organization_user sou on sou.organization_id = #{orgId} and sou.user_id = c.owner left join sys_department sd on sd.id = sou.department_id left join customer_field cf on cf.resource_id = c.id and cf.field_id = ( select mf.id from sys_module_field mf join sys_module_form form on mf.form_id = form.id where form.organization_id = #{orgId} and form.form_key = 'customer' and mf.internal_key = 'customerSource' limit 1 ) where c.id in
#{customerId}
